capabilities: Select a template automatically when a new file is created
Match file paths against regex or glob patterns
Reorder and delete rules with sorting arrows
Test rules against a typed path and report invalid patterns or templates
extras: Includes a worked example of day, week, month, quarter and year journal rules with regex patterns.
intentEvidence: This is made to be used with plugins like templater.
motivation: The author found that plugins like Periodic Notes and Templater do not catch every journal file being created, causing files to be formatted inconsistently.
problem: Obsidian's template plugins apply templates manually or only to specific file types, so files created by other plugins can end up inconsistently formatted.
